section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Altdorf; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Altdorf; other communes in Uri set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

label: Minimum tax on real estate
value: A minimum tax on real estate of natural persons who pay less than CHF 300 of cantonal, communal and church taxes in the canton
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer)
value: None as such: only land registry or transfer fees are charged (amounts not stored)
note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)
